request.style: English, Male solo voice, warm and storytelling, acoustic guitar, fiddle, piano, upright bass, steady rhythm, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Standing in the synagogue hall
They ask who he really is
Isn't he the carpenter
Working with his hands and skills

[Verse]
His mother is named Mary
Brothers James and Simon too
Joseph and Judas are there
Sisters watching as he grew

[Chorus]
Where did this man get all these things
The carpenter's son they say
Isn't this the son of Mary
Walking in our everyday

[Verse]
At the cross she stood nearby
Mother of James and Joseph
Watching from a distance
Holding her grief in her scope

[Chorus]
Where did this man get all these things
The carpenter's son they say
Isn't this the son of Mary
Walking in our everyday

[Outro]
She saw where he was laid
In the tomb of the silent grave
